LanguageData.NanoHive_Settings_Intro: These are the starting values for a new colony, and for a save from NanoHive 1.x the first time it loads. After that each save keeps its own values, and every hive has its own buttons.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Settings_InGame: This colony already has its own defaults, so changes here apply to your next new colony. To change this colony's default, set up a hive and click "Use as colony default".
LanguageData.NanoHive_Settings_Rate: Repair per target, each repair cycle: {0} HP
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_BuildingsDesc: Repair your colony's buildings in range. The hive always repairs itself.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_ItemsDesc: Repair items lying under a roof in range.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_GearDesc: Repair the apparel and equipment of your colonists in range.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_InventoryDesc: Repair items your colonists in range are carrying.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_OnlyStoredItemsDesc: Repair only items that are in a stockpile or storage and not forbidden. Leaves loot and junk on the floor alone.
LanguageData.NanoHive_Toggle_BuildingsFirstDesc: Spend the repair budget on buildings before items and gear. Otherwise the most damaged things go first.
LanguageData.NanoHive_RangeDesc: Set how far this hive reaches. Applies to every selected hive.
LanguageData.NanoHive_RateDesc: Set how many hit points each target gets per repair cycle (about every 4 seconds). The hive spends at most 40 times this per cycle in total, most damaged first. Applies to every selected hive.
LanguageData.NanoHive_MakeDefaultDesc: New hives in this colony start with this hive's settings.
LanguageData.NanoHive_CopyAllDesc: Give every hive on this map this hive's settings.
